title: Efreeti Bottle serving-efreeti stopper cannot schedule its 24h wait (no depleting operation)
description: olc5.12.1 finding. The stopper economy (cooldown, startsOn grant-ended serving-efreeti) has no operation that spends it. applyCooldownAnchorToState only schedules an anchored cooldown when the economy is already depleted (remaining 0), so the grant-ended event never starts the 24-hour wait. The pack needs a depletion representation at grant end (or a semantic change to the anchor, which is an itemState decision). Until then F5 grant-anchored stays unlanded for the stopper carrier. Pack change requires importer work and regeneration under docs/importer-fix-protocol.md.
close_reason: Resolved on eshyra-olc5.12.2 (commit b205724d): remove-stopper now spends the stopper, so the grant-ended anchor schedules the 24 h wait for the serving-efreeti carrier; conformance in itemGrantSummons.test.ts. Non-serving outcomes are tracked in eshyra-olc5.12.4.
